title: Regional MSL Manager, Neuroscience (Europe)
description:
**Description**


We are seeking an experienced and scientifically credible Regional MSL Manager to lead and support a team of Medical Science Liaisons across Europe within Neuroscience and Psychiatry.  

This role will focus on leveraging field medical expertise to accelerate clinical trial delivery through investigator engagement, site support, patient identification, enrolment, and retention initiatives for priority neuroscience programmes. The Regional MSL Manager will combine people leadership responsibilities with a strong operational focus, ensuring the field medical team effectively supports clinical development objectives whilst maintaining high\-quality scientific exchange with healthcare professionals and external stakeholders.


Working closely with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, and external study partners, the successful candidate will lead strategies that enhance study site performance, support patient recruitment goals, and generate valuable scientific insights from the field. The individual will remain closely connected to field activities, providing coaching and support to MSLs while driving excellence in trial support, stakeholder engagement, compliance, and execution.  

This position offers an opportunity to lead a high\-performing field medical team while contributing directly to the successful execution of clinical programmes and improved outcomes for patients living with neurological and psychiatric disorders.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Medical Science Liaisons across multiple European markets.
* Provide day\-to\-day line management, performance support, field coaching, and professional development for MSL team members.
* Develop and implement regional field medical strategies that support patient identification, enrolment, retention, and overall clinical trial execution.
* Partner closely with Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, and study teams to identify and address barriers to site activation and patient recruitment.
* Ensure MSLs maintain effective territory engagement plans with investigators, research centres, and referral networks to support study objectives.
* Support study feasibility assessments and site identification activities by leveraging scientific expertise and field insights.
* Facilitate compliant scientific engagement with Principal Investigators, study coordinators, healthcare professionals, and research site personnel.
* Accompany MSLs in the field to enhance scientific engagement capabilities and ensure consistent execution of best practices.
* Gather, analyse, and communicate actionable field insights relating to study execution, recruitment challenges, treatment pathways, and investigator needs.
* Work collaboratively with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Market Access, and Commercial teams to ensure aligned execution of programme objectives.
* Support clinical study steering committees, investigator meetings, advisory interactions, and other study\-related activities as appropriate.
* Define, monitor, and report key performance indicators related to field medical activities, site engagement, recruitment support, and team effectiveness.
* Support onboarding, training, and capability development programmes for new and existing MSL team members, including clinical trial support competencies.
* Ensure all activities are conducted in full compliance with applicable regulations, industry codes, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), pharmacovigilance requirements, and company policies.

**Requirements:**

* Advanced scientific degree (PharmD, PhD, MD, MBBS, MSc, or equivalent).
* Previous experience as a Medical Science Liaison with demonstrated success in a field medical role.
* Prior line management, team leadership, or mentoring experience within Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, or Field Medical organisations.
* Strong scientific knowledge within Neuroscience, Psychiatry, or related therapeutic areas.
* Experience supporting clinical research, clinical trial execution, site engagement, patient recruitment, or investigator\-sponsored studies.
* Working knowledge of clinical development processes, trial operations, and Good Clinical Practice (GCP).
* Experience collaborating with Clinical Operations, Clinical Development, and cross\-functional study teams.
* Proven ability to engage effectively with healthcare professionals, key opinion leaders, investigators, and research site personnel through scientific exchange.
* Ability to translate field insights into meaningful recommendations that support both Medical Affairs and Clinical Development objectives.
* Strong communication, coaching, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working within complex cross\-functional pharmaceutical or biotechnology environments.
* Solid understanding of compliance, pharmacovigilance, and ethical requirements governing medical activities and clinical research interactions.
* Ability to operate effectively across multiple countries and cultures within a matrix organisation.
* Fluency in English; additional European languages are advantageous.


Willingness to travel extensively across Europe. This role offers the opportunity to shape regional neuroscience strategy, lead diverse international medical teams, and drive scientific excellence across multiple global markets while improving outcomes for patients affected by neurological and psychiatric disorders.


At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Here, the work is challenging, and the pace is exhilarating. By joining one of our commercial teams, you’re empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy that you need. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Syneos Health has launched more sales teams in the last 5 years across all major therapeutic areas than the top 25 pharma companies combined. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients. Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.


Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

**JOB TITLE:** Partnerships Consultant

**TYPE OF CONTRACT:** CST REG

 **BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE OF THE ASSIGNMENT:**


WFP’s Partnerships Department's Country Office Support Hub (PPDR) helps Country Offices protect, grow and diversify their partnerships and resourcing across public and private donors.


Based on Country Office needs, PPDR provides operational, strategic and business development support to strengthen resource mobilization and partnership management across a range of partners.


PPDR assists Country Offices in navigatin\`g main corporate reporting and partnership planning processes. PPDR also promotes knowledge management and learning across WFP to ensure teams have the information and tools they need to enhance partnerships. PPDR works closely with Partnerships divisions, Global Offices, Regional Director Offices and other Headquarters divisions to deliver timely, practical and high quality support.


The Consultant will report to the Country Office Support Team Lead. The Consultant will work in coordination with donor account managers and regional offices. The Consultant will support COs' partnership journey from planning to opportunity confirmation and is expected to travel to the field where requested. The Consultant will support a designated set of Country Offices and act as a focal point for specific corporate processes, donor accounts and themes.

 **ACCOUNTABILITIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:**


1\. Provide strategic advice and analysis to Country Offices (COs) engaged in the development of Country Strategic Plans and related Partnering \& Resourcing Strategies (PRS).


2\. Provide hands\-on support to COs in designing and drafting proposals, general and donor\-specific value propositions, regular and ad hoc reports, and communication and advocacy products.


3\. Conduct funding landscape assessments (donor mapping) aimed at exploring diversified funding opportunities for specific funding gaps identified by COs.


4\. Develop tailored donor engagement plans to support CO fundraising efforts.


5\. If required, support COs with donor engagement, working as point of contact for problem solving between donor focal points across Global Offices and HQ, and CO teams.


6\. Prepare briefing materials, presentations, and pitches for high\-value donor engagements.


7\. Provide surge support during emergencies or peak periods (virtual or in\-person).


8\. Maintain up\-to\-date CO and partner knowledge, relying on available information from Salesforce, CO and Partnerships Department (PI). Track and analyze resource mobilization results across COs.


9\. Contribute to HQ information requests and Senior Management briefs on CO partnerships. Specifically, prepare resourcing and partnerships briefs for emergency operations and consolidate inputs from Accounts team/Global Offices/other PI department and provide resourcing overview for Senior Management briefs.


10\. Manage and route CO support requests to relevant focal points, and facilitate information flow between COs and PI, legal, finance, and technical teams.


11\. Support development of guidance and feed lessons learned and best practices into the PI knowledge system.


12\. Identify and escalate partnership risks (e.g., compliance, reputational, funding gaps) to PI management.


13\. Undertake any other duties as required by the supervisor.

* Project proposals
* Value propositions
* Guidance and lessons learned
* Temporary deployment
* Operational support

 **QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:**

**Education:** A master's degree or equivalent in one or more of the following disciplines: political science, economics, international affairs, public administration, social sciences, development studies, or any other field related to international development or humanitarian assistance.

 **Experience:** Between 5\-8 years of working experience in development, consultancy, research, humanitarian response would be preferable. Working directly in or with WFP operations is an asset. Previous work experience in various country contexts and with partnerships management strongly preferred.

 **Knowledge \& Skills:** The ideal candidate will have diverse mix of experience related to the portfolio, and would benefit from familiarity with WFP’s operations, policy, planning and partnerships. The candidate should have a multidisciplinary and versatile professional experience, working in various sectors. He/She should be a self\-starter, organised, flexible and comfortable with working with multiple internal and external actors and to tight deadlines. Strong writing, analytical and research skills; good interpersonal skills, teamwork spirit and ability to work in multicultural settings; superior cognitive capacity.

 **Languages:** Proficiency/level C of English (requirement); Proficiency in at least one other WFP working language(s) required (French, Spanish, Arabic, Russian, Portuguese, or Chinese)

**✍️ Cosa richiediamo?**
* Laurea in Fisica, Ingegneria Elettronica, Ottica, Fotonica o discipline affini, preferibilmente con una tesi sperimentale su sensori infrarossi, termocamere, spettroscopia, ottica o analisi dei segnali.

* Conoscenza di elettromagnetismo, ottica e ottica applicata, fisica quantistica, elaborazione dei segnali o delle immagini.
* Familiarità con strumenti di laboratorio quali spettrometri, oscilloscopi, fotodiodi, filtri ottici, rivelatori IR e sistemi di acquisizione dati.
* Buona conoscenza dell’italiano e disponibilità a lavorare full onsite a Roma, con avvio previsto a dicembre.

**Nice to have:**
* Conoscenza di applicazioni di telerilevamento, sorveglianza, tracking o comunicazioni in fibra ottica.


✨ **Che cosa offriamo?**
* Una comunità internazionale che riunisce oltre 110 nazionalità diverse.

* Un solido sistema di formazione con Academy interna e moduli disponibili.

**Benefici locali in Italia:**
* Buoni pasto.
* Opzioni di lavoro flessibili secondo policy aziendale.
* Assicurazione sanitaria e programmi di benessere, ove applicabili.


**Remunerazione e trasparenza**
* Gross Annual Salary Range: EUR 24\.000 – EUR 36\.000\.
* CCNL del Commercio.
* La fascia retributiva è definita secondo criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere.
* Durante il processo di selezione non chiederemo informazioni sulla tua retribuzione attuale o precedente.


Le nostre fasce retributive sono volutamente ampie, perché cerchiamo persone di talento, non «profili standard». Uno stesso ruolo può attrarre candidature molto diverse tra loro, e crediamo sia importante lasciare spazio a questa varietà. La collocazione all’interno della fascia dipenderà dalla tua esperienza specifica, dalle tue competenze e da ciò che potrai portare nel ruolo.

**La persona ideale si riconosce in questi valori:**

**Boldness:** il nostro spirito di avventura imprenditoriale è ciò che ci unisce tutti e ci porta al successo.
**Trust:** la fiducia è il fondamento di tutte le relazioni e favorisce libertà di espressione, creatività e innovazione.
**Performance:** un desiderio costante di andare avanti e di chiedere di più a noi stessi.
**Commitment:** lavoriamo con responsabilità e determinazione per ottenere grandi risultati.
**Independence:** Amaris Consulting appartiene a chi l’ha creata e a chi la sviluppa ogni giorno.

L’opportunità si colloca nell’ambito dei sistemi elettro\-ottici, della fotonica e della sensoristica avanzata, con attività sperimentali di verifica, caratterizzazione e analisi delle prestazioni.  


**Diversità e Inclusione**
Amaris Consulting promuove pari opportunità e valuta le candidature sulla base di competenze, esperienza e potenziale. Accogliamo candidature qualificate senza discriminazioni legate a genere, identità o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, origine etnica, nazionalità, religione o convinzioni personali, età, disabilità, stato civile o familiare o altre caratteristiche protette.
Se hai bisogno di adattamenti ragionevoli durante il processo di selezione, comunicacelo: faremo il possibile per supportarti.
**Who are we?**
---------------


**Amaris Consulting** is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System \& Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential. Amaris is your steppingstone to cross rivers of change, meet challenges and achieve all your projects with success.
  

  

At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience. We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like:
  

  

**Brief Call**: Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you!
  

  

**Interviews** (the average number of interviews is 3 \- the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your line manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities!
  

  

**Case study**: Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem\-solving scenario, etc.
  

  

As you know, every person is different and so is every role in a company. That is why we have to adapt accordingly, and the process may differ slightly at times. However, please know that we always put ourselves in the candidate's shoes to ensure they have the best possible experience.
  

We look forward to meeting you!

* supporto nella identificazione e gestione di partner progettuali.



Tutte le attività elencate dovranno essere realizzate in stretto raccordo con le aree Programmatiche di riferimento (principalmente tramite le figure dei Program Manager e dei coordinatori di progetto), la Direzione Finance (Aree Legal, Grant e Contabilità) e sotto la supervisione della Head of Financial Planning and Analysis.

* partecipare a meeting convocati dagli eventuali donatori;

description:
TXT Group is an international, IT end\-to\-end provider of consultancy, software solutions and services, supporting the digital transformation of customers’ products and core processes. With a proprietary software portfolio and deep expertise in vertical domains, TXT Group operates across different markets, with a growing footprint in Aerospace, Aviation, Defense, Industrial, Government and Fintech. The holding company, TXT e\-Solutions, has been listed on the Italian Stock Exchange \- STAR segment (TXT.MI) \- since July 2000\. TXT Group headquartered in Milan and has subsidiaries in Italy, Germany, the United Kingdom, France, Switzerland and the United States of America.
  
  

**Quality Engineer:**  

For one of our key clients operating in the Defence sector, we are looking for a Quality Engineer to support the entire product lifecycle, ensuring compliance with quality, contractual, and regulatory requirements.
  
  

**Main Responsibilities:**  

Act as the Quality focal point and interface with Engineering teams.
  
Participate in project reviews and technical review boards.
  
Support development\-to\-production transition activities.
  
Verify and assess product documentation packages and deliverables.
  
Perform product acceptance and inspection activities.
  
Participate in qualification and validation testing campaigns.
  
Define, collect and report quality metrics and performance indicators.
  
Support the update and maintenance of Quality Management Plans and related documentation.
  
  

**Required Skills:**  

Solid knowledge of system lifecycle processes according to MIL\-STD\-2167A and MIL\-STD\-498 standards.
  
Previous experience in Defence environments and familiarity with the processes typically adopted in military programs.
  
Knowledge of Quality Assurance procedures, methodologies, and processes.
  
Experience in Verification and Acceptance activities.
  
Knowledge and management of Quality Notifications (QN).
  
Familiarity with processes and documentation related to ADP, CVS, TDR, and QTR.
  
Ability to monitor product and process compliance against contractual and regulatory requirements.
  
Experience in managing non\-conformities and corrective actions.
  
Knowledge of quality documentation and operational practices within Defence programs.
  
Ability to prepare and manage quality reports, metrics, and KPIs.
  
Experience supporting audits, program reviews, and compliance verification activities.
  
Continuous improvement mindset and commitment to maintaining high\-quality standards.
  
  

**Soft Skills:**  

Teamwork and collaboration skills.
  
Reliability and accountability.
  
Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
  
Attention to detail and a quality\-oriented mindset.
  
Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
  

**Education:**  

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  
  

**Why choose TXT Group:**  

Career opportunities in a fast\-growing and rapidly changing company with young, international staff
  
Training on business\-related topics
  
Corporate Benefits (health insurance, welfare, Ticket Restaurant, discounts as a group employee)
  
The contract offered for this position is a permanent one, and the salary range for this position is between EUR 40\.000 € and EUR 45\.000 € gross per year.
  
The grading/level will be defined during the selection process based on the candidate's profile and in accordance with the National Collective Labor Agreement (Metalworking Industry).
  
  

Position is open to all applicants regardless of gender, in accordance with Italian Legislative Decree 198/2006\. The company promotes equal opportunities and values diversity in all its forms.
